name: Demand Spike / Demand Volatility Scenario
description: Tests response to heavier and more volatile rolling demand.

expected_override_effects.rolling_demand_probability_multiplier: Increases probability of rolling order generation.
expected_override_effects.rolling_demand_volume_multiplier: Increases max rolling orders per step.
expected_override_effects.clustered_spike_windows: PARTIAL: aggregate demand stress is applied; explicit time-window spike generator is not yet implemented.

expected_behavior: PPO may increase useful inventory posture and DQN should increase productive dispatch while preserving feasibility.
